name: release
title: 릴리스 — 버전 자르기
use: Cutting a version: audit, full gate, CHANGELOG section, release notes, owner confirm, local tag.
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
NEVER restart the live viewer. NEVER push (no commits, no tags). NEVER create a tag before the owner confirms in 확인.
No runtime switch or new dependency: propose it in summary only.
Screenshots only from a --demo viewer (never the live viewer: rule 1, metadata only).

stages.title: 점검
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <this repo> --category security --dev` once from this repository: it runs the security scanners and the dependency/runtime audit (scripts/deps_audit.py, incl. its --dev tooling lines) and writes one Markdown report. Its printed summary line ends with `· report <name>` (plus `· deps N FAIL/M WARN`); the report is ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<name> (find it with `ls ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/*/<name>`). Read it and report as findings every FAIL/WARN line of «Dependencies and runtimes» (item and detail only) and every scanner finding (rule id, file:line, severity); name tools that were skipped, missing or failed. List OK lines in summary. Change nothing; do not rerun.

stages.title: 전체 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report each failing step as a finding with file/line. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: CHANGELOG 정리
stages.task: Backfill CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] from `git log` since the last tag (or the last versioned section): one line per user-visible feature or fix under Added/Changed/Fixed; skip refactors, tests and docs-only commits. Rename [Unreleased] to [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD and add a new empty [Unreleased] above it. Edit CHANGELOG.md only; do not commit.

stages.title: 릴리스 노트
stages.task: Write the release notes from the new [x.y.z] section: 3-5 highlights, then the section as is. Screenshots only from a --demo viewer. List the open issues of GitHub milestone x.y.z (`gh issue list --milestone x.y.z --state open`) and end the notes with one line that repeats the keyword per issue, `Closes #N, closes #M, ...` (GitHub closes only the issue right after each keyword). Put the notes in the session scratchpad and report the path; do not commit.

stages.title: 확인
stages.task: Stop. The orchestrator shows the owner the version, the CHANGELOG diff and the notes path, and waits for an explicit confirm. ⚠No tag and no push before the owner says so.

stages.title: 태그
stages.task: Only after the owner confirmed in 확인: commit CHANGELOG.md alone (the commit body ends with the `Closes #N, closes #M, ...` line from the notes, so the issues close when main receives it), then create an annotated tag vX.Y.Z on that commit (git tag -a). ⚠Never push commits or tags. Report the commit hash and the tag.
